content:
Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

All the Pensioners / Family Pensioners to register for Aadhaar and furnish information to the Pension Disbursing Authority to enable them update the 'Jeevan Pramaan'. - OM, dated 31-3-2015.  
In order to update the Jeevan Pramaan, the following information should be furnished by the pensioner, for incorporation of Aadhaar Number in PPO Booklet.  
1. PAN
2. Aadhaar No. (if available)
3. Mobile No. (if available)
4. e-mail ID (if available).  
- OM, dated 2-6-2015.
